notes: Text to Video: land on the new scenes when a batch finishes. On completion the status handler reloads scenes with loadSegments(0) (authoritative, no empty-retry); if it produced scenes it now closes the Text-to-Video panel (modal or standalone screen) and drops the user straight onto the freshly-generated scenes, plus a brief localised success toast ('N scenes ready' / 'N個のシーンができました', EN+JA). If the batch produced zero scenes (parse/render failure) the panel is left open so its error log stays visible — no silent close, no misleading toast. Builds on v1.4.71's auto-refresh. Verified: success path closes + toasts with the right count, failure path keeps the panel open with no toast, no console errors.
